title: 检索可解释性
summary: 检索排序不是黑盒总分。先定稀疏与向量的分数不可直接相加，再把得分拆解为词频饱和与篇幅惩罚。
summaryEn: Search ranking is not a black-box total score. Never add sparse and dense scores directly; decompose scores into term frequency saturation and document length penalty.
asks: 检索排序怎么让人看明白？
asksEn: How should search ranking and score breakdown be explained?
